market.question: Will the highest temperature in Busan be 24°C on May 7?

assessment.reasoning: Busan/Gimhae May 7, 2026 forecast around 70°F (~21°C) per AccuWeather monthly. Question asks if high will be exactly 24°C bin. Forecast is ~3°C below target, making 24°C unlikely without warming surprise. Average daily highs in May at Busan rise from 69°F to 76°F, and 24°C (75°F) is upper-end of range.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Warm-air advection could push highs to 24°C
